about: The chase backdrop of screen 13, as data. Units are game units (512 x 384 a screen); x of an element is its left edge in its layer, y its base line (feet). First guesses, tuned live.

fangs.about: Spurs of basalt riding by behind the play layer, rising from below the bottom edge. w and h - a picture's size in units at the scale of 1. A low one's top stands where the near ground hides the city's feet; a tall one (only the kinds marked tall) over the city, never two on the screen. The game only, the stand does not play them.

camera.about: One camera for the city: the crater floor's horizon and the base line of the domes, the focal length in units. A thing whose feet stand at y is k = (y - horizon) / (baseY - horizon) as near as the domes' centres: drawn k times their size and riding k times their speed, so the lower its feet, the nearer and the faster; a thing hanging in the air (the monorail's beam) gives the feet of what it stands on as groundY. The stand and the game play it.

frames.about: The dome frames, drawn by code: geodesic half-ellipsoids, x the left edge along the city layer, w the width and h the height at the base line, frequency how finely the icosahedron is cut, rib the thickness of a rib in units. Their far half is drawn behind the buildings, the near half over them. The stand and the game play them.

cityKit.about: The city's buildings, cut from the sheets by tools/chase/cut_sheet.py: their size in units at the scale of the domes' centres (k = 1). Every one is packed into the set, placed or not; the stand offers them to place.

cityLights.about: The lights of the city's pieces, proposed by tools/chase/find_lights.py from their saturation and kept by eye. A light of a piece is a box in shares of its picture (u, v from the top left, w, h) and a colour; it rides with every building drawn from the piece, mirrored with it. A neon sign flickers, each on its own clock; a strip - a guide light along a beam or a train - burns steady; a window (a dark ribbon of the picture, found by find_lights.py --windows) is lit for spans of spanTicks, onShare of them, catching with a flicker; a lamp (box [u, v, 0, 0], set by hand at a mast's tip) blinks as the frames' beacons do. Drawn added over the building after it, not dimmed by its shade. neon/strip: the core is the box scaled by core (w, h), the halo the box scaled by halo and grown by haloPad units on each side at the domes' nearness; the levels 0..1. flicker: ticks of 1/33 s - a breath of breathDepth over breathTicks, and windows of windowTicks, faultShare of them carrying a fault: flips of flipTicks each, down to faultLow and back. The stand and the game play it.

emblem.about: The TEK emblem, a neon sign standing on the lower point of its frame on the tip of the central spire: made by tools/chase/make_emblem.py from the emblem's picture - the metal (tek-emblem), a tube along the edge of each part (tek-N) and its glow (tek-N-halo); the boxes are shares of the emblem, the parts in the order they light. on - the piece it stands on, at - the tip there in shares of its picture; w its width in units at the domes' nearness, scaled by the building's; the metal drawn at shade, the tubes and glows added in color. The parts burn on a clock of their own: now and then a tired flicker (the flicker of the signs, its faultShare replaced), and every relightTicks the whole sign goes out for darkTicks and lights again part after part, partTicks apart, each catching with a stutter. The stand and the game play it.

beacons.about: Red warning lights on the nodes of the dome frames above the share of their height named per frame (beaconsAbove): a dim glow and a short flash, each on its own period, phase taken from the node's place. size and halo in units at the node's nearness.

train.about: One train shuttling on the monorail between the city's two stations (the elements drawn from station, both at one depth - the train's): a dwell at a station, a run to the other, back. mouth - where a station's box begins, a share of its picture from the end the beam enters (the left one, unmirrored); the train is shown between the two mouths only, cut where it goes in. At a stop its nose stands inside units past the mouth. w its width in units, y its feet, shade as a building's. A run pushes up to cruise (units a second along the line) over accelTicks, rolls on and comes down the same way; a dwell lasts dwellTicks, the dice of the stand. Its lights are the cityLights of piece. The stand and the game play it.

searchlights.about: Warm searchlights of the main dome, wandering over the sky. A beam is drawn by code at the depth of its lamp (y its feet, x along the city layer, lift how high the lamp stands over its feet - hidden behind the front row): bright in the air of the dome, from level at the lamp to glassLevel at the dome's silhouette, a hot spot there and a step down to tailShare of it, then a faint tail of tail units in the lunar dust; glints where it crosses the near ribs. Its half width is rootHalf plus spread a unit of its length. Its angle in degrees (-90 straight up): aim plus two slow waves (sweep, periodTicks) on a clock of its own that now and then eases to a hold (pause). Units at the lamp's depth. The stand and the game play it.

farm.about: The farm under the long dome at the end of the city's strip (chase-backdrop.md, "The farm"): greenhouses of the kit whose glass glows from inside. glass - the lit glass of each piece, found by tools/chase/make_glow.py: its picture <id>-glow is drawn over the shaded piece, not shaded; its colour, its centre in shares of the picture and its share of the picture light the dome's air. glow - each greenhouse's grow light on a clock of its own: spans of spanTicks, onShare of them lit; it comes on over warmTicks (a sodium lamp warms up) with a flicker, and goes out at once; level is the glass at full. air - the light the farm gives the air in the dome: every lit greenhouse a source of its colour, its strength its glass at its nearness times level, falling off as exp(-(d / reach)^2) in units at the dome's nearness, taken at the corners of the dome's near half and drawn added over the buildings; the far ribs take ribLevel of it on their inner face. apron - the light out of the glass on the floor in front of the dome: from its near foot toward the eye for length units of the floor, fading out, level of the air there; the ribs' feet throw gaps of gap units. glareKeep - the sun's glare over the dome when the dome stands before the disc, as a share of itself: the glass shines through it, eased in over the sun's tint ramp. The stand and the game play it.
